title: AI Provider Implementations
summary: This module provides abstractions for integrating with various AI model APIs, encompassing OpenAI-compatible services, native SDKs, and specialized offerings, along with utilities for managing model configurations.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible Providers
nodes.title: OpenAI API Compatible Providers
nodes.description: Manages connections and interactions with a wide range of AI services that offer an OpenAI-compatible API surface.

nodes.label: Native SDK Providers
nodes.title: Native SDK AI Providers
nodes.description: Integrates with AI services using their specific Python SDKs for deeper or unique functionalities.

nodes.label: Gateway & Specialized Providers
nodes.title: AI Gateways and Specialized Services
nodes.description: Handles routing to multiple AI models, provides structured output capabilities, and integrates with AI gateways like Vercel and LiteLLM.

nodes.label: Model Profile Helpers
nodes.title: Model Configuration Profiles
nodes.description: Contains utility functions and profiles for defining the capabilities and characteristics of various AI models across different providers.

groups.label: Core LLM Providers
groups.title: Core LLM Providers
groups.description: The fundamental components for interacting with various large language models, either through OpenAI-compatible interfaces or native SDKs.

groups.label: Advanced & Specialized
groups.title: Advanced and Specialized AI Services
groups.description: Modules that provide enhanced capabilities such as multi-model routing, structured generation, or specific gateway integrations.

groups.label: Configuration Utilities
groups.title: Model Configuration Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions and data structures for defining and managing the operational characteristics and capabilities of different AI models.
